contract.title: CISO / ISO Executive Cyber Risk Dashboard Visual Unification
acceptance_criteria: Only ExecutiveOverviewPage TSX CSS and focused test may change; every frozen Executive routing layout widget shell workspace backend provider runtime environment task and reference file remains unchanged.

The immutable visual authority is .ai/references/TASK-0126-product-owner-mockup.png with SHA-256 93913bda9d7c281075ea9790c37d2ea1d41093ce1233d6650db55c4b8c68d282, dimensions 1467 x 1072 and size 1411946 bytes.

The overview renders only the strategic header, five ordered KPI instruments, Enterprise Risk Overview, Decision Priorities, Business Impact, Critical Business Services, Investment and Remediation Priorities, Executive Briefing, Security Program Progress, Board Reporting and explicit fail-closed footer.

All five KPI instruments remain number-free and show truthful Unavailable or Not connected states; Risk Trend retains direction-neutral chart structure without a trend path, points, values or historical claims.
Enterprise Risk Overview uses recognizable neutral ring and legend geometry without unequal data segments, risk levels, percentages, scores or claimed category values.
Decision Priorities, Critical Business Services and Investment Priorities use empty fail-closed table geometry without synthetic rows, priorities, impacts, services, initiatives, amounts or targets.
Business Impact keeps people, financial, operational and compliance categories visibly unavailable without amounts, scales, relative magnitudes or comparisons.
Executive Briefing and Board Reporting remain Unavailable or Not connected without briefing content, board metrics, reports, schedules, relative times or last-updated values.
Security Program Progress uses only symmetric or neutral unavailable geometry with no progress lengths, percentages, relative achievement or milestone claims.
The overview does not call any Executive, decision, report, team-risk, finding, incident, hypothesis, provider or other data boundary and does not introduce an API client or frontend business logic.
At 1467 x 1072 and 100 percent zoom page-local CSS follows the measured main region, strategic header and five-card row while fitting the existing positive 24px ExecutiveLayout border-box inset.
The five KPI cards independently follow approximate widths 241 241 240 238 and 239px with approximately 12 to 13px gaps and complete fit without overflow or clipping.
The four two-column rows preserve approximate 597px left and 634px right panels with approximately 15px column gap and respective heights 213 174 152 and 168px within task tolerances.
Major vertical gaps remain approximately 10 to 11px and panel borders radii and internal insets remain approximately 1px 8px and 15 to 17px within task tolerances.
No page element uses a negative margin, transform, external offset, viewport-width compensation, shell modification, clipping or document-level horizontal overflow to force PNG alignment.

Deterministic tests model viewport, frozen 164px Sidebar, Main track, positive 24px ExecutiveLayout inset, page content width, five-card arithmetic, two-column widths, row heights and all gaps without claiming native jsdom pixel or font measurement.

Negative truthfulness fixtures reject numeric KPIs, scores, percentages, risk levels, unequal distributions, trend paths, points, priority ordering, business-impact claims, services, investments, program progress, board metrics and timestamps.
WorkspaceId.EXECUTIVE, visible CISO / ISO identity, every canonical /executive route, Sidebar selection, WorkspaceSwitcher, Back and Forward behavior and URL authority remain unchanged and passing.
Focused Executive tests, Executive layout and route regressions, shell and cross-workspace regressions, TASK-0122 through TASK-0125 regressions and full frontend regression pass.
TypeScript, production build and git diff --check pass; Scope Guard reports exactly the three authorized files and all Product Owner reference hashes remain unchanged.
Architect Implementation Review directly verifies the rendered hierarchy, numerical geometry and fail-closed semantics; generic green validators alone do not authorize PASS.
Product Owner browser acceptance at 1467 x 1072 and 100 percent zoom remains mandatory before DONE.
Do not transition TASK-0126 to DONE or create TASK-0127.
